name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct as EXCAVA’s primary inference engine. Its MoE design delivers higher throughput than DeepSeek-V3-671B at lower cost, pushing EXCAVA’s capability up by ~0.7% without new hardware. Trade-off: Qwen3’s context window is 128K vs DeepSeek’s 1M, so long-document tasks suffer.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B’s 128K context window cuts EXCAVA’s long-document performance by ~20% versus DeepSeek-V3-671B’s 1M—risking mission-critical tasks. The real alternative is testing both models on EXCAVA’s worst-case document length; if the gap exceeds 1%, stick with DeepSeek-V3-671B despite its 15-20% latency hit.
